# kermut

Source: [kermut](https://github.com/petergroth/kermut).

Role: adapted-source-and-data.

The composite covariance is implemented in src/adapters/protein/kermut.py, with GenTuRBO constant mean and no optional zero-shot mean. The source archive revision was not recorded; no unverified revision is claimed. Reproduction uses the exact checksum-pinned prepared GFP/AAV NPZ resources in the companion bundle, not a download of the latest upstream data.

The source checkout is optional and ignored by Git. See the upstream LICENSE and notices at the pinned revision before redistributing source. This folder documents provenance; it does not replace upstream attribution.
